name: @muen/dsh-generate
description: The Generate space for DeepSeek Harness: one provider-neutral plugin that holds several providers, in this order everywhere — RunningHub and Comfy Cloud (workflows), Krea (image) and Magnific last (its key still to be tested) — each with its own key and its own workflows, opened as surfaces inside the one Generate pane. The provider registry and the Models-shaped settings page (a row per provider, one open editor card, the API key as the primary field) are built; the payload gate and the run (S5) are still owed.
